walkthroughs.body_html:
Countries are grouped by income.

HIC = High Income, NEE = Newly Emerging Economy, LIC = Low Income.

The World Bank sets the thresholds yearly.

Two common measures.

GNI per capita shows average income per person.

HDI blends income, schooling and life expectancy into one figure from 0 to 1.

Single measures can mislead.

An oil-rich state may have high GNI but low literacy.

Using multiple indicators gives a fuller picture of development.

mcqs.q: Why is HDI a better measure of development than GNI per capita?
options: Sustainable development means using only solar power.
HDI combines income, life expectancy and education, capturing quality of life — GNI per capita is just average income and hides inequality and non-economic wellbeing.
Because HDI is easier to calculate than GNI.
Because HDI measures how happy people are.

mcqs.q: Why do earthquakes typically cause more deaths in LICs than HICs?
options: LICs have more earthquake deaths because more earthquakes happen there.
LICs often have poorly enforced building codes, weak emergency response, dense informal housing and limited preparedness — not because the earthquakes are stronger.
Sustainable development means using only solar power.
HICs never have earthquake deaths because of advanced technology.
Sustainable development means stopping all economic growth.
Sustainable development means using only solar power.
HICs never have earthquake deaths because of advanced technology.
Development that meets the needs of the present without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs — balancing economic, social and environmental goals.
